'''Akshae Shanka''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] donned with silver and blue [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] and a notorious [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who operated out of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] around [[3643 BBY]]. He was greatly feared by the populace of Nal Hutta, and had come in second in two separate [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunts]].
